plugin.name: YouTubeDirect
plugin.title: YouTube Direct
plugin.desc: YouTube audio for Lyrion with SponsorBlock: sponsor reads and the non-music parts of mixes are cut out as you listen. Search, follow channels, playlists, links and chapters. Installs and updates its own yt-dlp (no shell access needed); API key optional. Built for Lyrion 9.0 servers that can't upgrade; works on 8.x and 9.x.
plugin.creator: Ethan Rosch
